音频反应视频播放头工作流程，作者：weshouldhaveshotguns

此工作流程提供了一种直观的方法，可以在 ComfyUI 中创建令人惊叹的音频反应视频效果。它专为短视频剪辑（<5 秒）和音频输入而设计，使用 4 个音频通道动态调制视频播放头，提供精确且视觉上引人注目的结果。底鼓的光芒特别好，但所有通道都同样强大，让您可以对音频反应项目进行完全的创意控制。

特别感谢 RyanOnTheInside
如果没有 RyanOnTheInside 开发的令人难以置信的节点，这个工作流程就不会存在。他的开创性工作为这一设置和无数其他创意可能性奠定了基础。

请务必探索他的 YouTube 频道和 GitHub 存储库，以获取教程和思想宝库：

  • GitHub：https://github.com/ryanontheinside/ComfyUI_RyanOnTheInside

  • YouTube：https://www.youtube.com/@ryanontheinside

主要特点：

  • 流线型设计：Ryan 完成了优化工作流程的繁重工作，而我通过折叠节点、添加详细的纲要并专注于易用性进一步简化了工作流程。

  • 音视频同步：通过 4 个不同通道的调制，轻松将视频同步到音频输入，非常适合创建动态的音频反应效果。

无论您是尝试音乐视频、生成艺术还是视觉效果，此工作流程都可以让音频反应创意变得简单、高效且有趣。潜入其中，看看您可以创造出什么样的动态视觉效果！

AUDIO-REACTIVE VIDEO PLAYHEAD WORKFLOW by weshouldhaveshotguns

This workflow brings an intuitive approach to creating stunning audio-reactive video effects in ComfyUI. Designed for short video clips (<5 seconds) and audio input, it dynamically modulates the video playhead using 4 audio channels, providing precise and visually striking results. The kick drum shines particularly well, but all channels are equally powerful, giving you full creative control over your audio-reactive projects.

Special Thanks to RyanOnTheInside
This workflow wouldn’t exist without the incredible nodes developed by RyanOnTheInside. His groundbreaking work lays the foundation for this setup and countless other creative possibilities.

Be sure to explore his YouTube channel and GitHub repository for tutorials and a treasure trove of ideas:

  • GitHub:https://github.com/ryanontheinside/ComfyUI_RyanOnTheInside

  • YouTube:https://www.youtube.com/@ryanontheinside

Key Features:

  • Streamlined Design:Ryan has done the heavy lifting to optimize the workflow, and I’ve simplified it further by collapsing nodes, adding a detailed rundown, and focusing on ease of use.

  • Audio-Video Synchronization:Effortlessly sync your video to your audio input with modulation across 4 distinct channels, perfect for creating dynamic, audio-reactive effects.

Whether you’re experimenting with music videos, generative art, or visual effects, this workflow makes audio-reactive creativity straightforward, efficient, and fun. Dive in and see what dynamic visuals you can create!
